en-US.name: Stickman Video Director
en-US.summary: Stickman animation skill that turns scripts into faceless videos with voiceover, captions and an audio library. MIT license is present, but this snapshot stays listing-only: 176 files over 1 MiB (about 812 MiB), including 112 inside skills/directing-stickman-videos, so a git install of the skill path exceeds the ordinary audit budget.
